Stream to Smart TVs and media players
DLNA lets nearby Smart TVs, gaming consoles, VLC, and Kodi discover this phone as a media server on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot.
DLNA is on. Start a sharing session from the home screen to make this phone visible.
DLNA is off. Turn it on to be discoverable when a sharing session is active.
1. Make sure your TV is on the same Wi-Fi network as this phone.
2. On this phone, start a sharing session from the home screen.
3. On your TV, open the media or source menu (sometimes called \"Inputs\", \"Apps\", or \"Media\").
4. Look for \"DirectServe Media Server\" in the source list and select it.
5. Browse your shared videos, music, and photos directly from the TV remote.
1. Open VLC on your laptop, desktop, or mobile device.
2. Go to View → Playlist (desktop) or open the side menu (mobile).
3. Look for \"Universal Plug \'n\' Play\" or \"Local Network\" in the sidebar.
4. Select \"DirectServe Media Server\" from the discovered devices.
5. Browse and play your shared media directly inside VLC.
Works with Kodi, Windows Media Player, PlayStation, Xbox, and most modern Smart TVs that support DLNA or UPnP.
If your TV does not see this phone, make sure both are on the same Wi-Fi network or hotspot.
Public Wi-Fi sometimes blocks device-to-device discovery. Use your phone hotspot as a reliable fallback.
DLNA only works while a sharing session is active. Start a session from the home screen first.

Use the Live Screen feature to mirror your phone screen to nearby devices on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot.
Enable PIN protection to require connected devices to verify with a code before they can view your live screen.
You can create a new PIN anytime during a live screen session by tapping the Regenerate PIN button.
Set a custom PIN in Settings if you prefer a specific code instead of auto-generated ones.
